## Kling 4.0 Flash API

Kling 4.0 Flash is a text to video, image to video, reference to video and video editing model by Kling AI, available on the Venice API as `kling-v4-flash-text-to-video`. Requests are anonymized, so the provider never sees your identity.

Kling 4.0 Flash is a faster version of Kling AI's Kling 4.0, generating 3- to 20-second clips at 720p from text with native audio.

### Kling 4.0 Flash API pricing

| Model ID | Variant | Privacy | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kling-v4-flash-text-to-video` | Text to video | Anonymized | from $0.1174 / sec |
| `kling-v4-flash-image-to-video` | Image to video | Anonymized | from $0.1174 / sec |
| `kling-v4-flash-reference-to-video` | Reference to video | Anonymized | from $0.1175 / sec |
| `kling-v4-flash-video-to-video` | Video edit | Anonymized | priced by source |

Clip prices for `kling-v4-flash-text-to-video` with audio:

| Duration | 720p |
|---|---|
| Per second | $0.1174 |
| 3s | $0.35 |
| 5s | $0.59 |
| 10s | $1.17 |
| 20s | $2.35 |

Any length from 3 to 20 seconds, priced per second.

### Kling 4.0 Flash specifications

| Spec | Value |
|---|---|
| Provider | Kling AI |
| Released | Nov 5, 2026 |
| Privacy | Anonymized |
| Status | Stable |
| Modes | text to video, image to video, reference to video and video editing |
| Resolutions | 720p |
| Durations | 3–20s, any whole second |
| Aspect ratios | 16:9, 9:16, 1:1, 21:9 |
| Audio | Always generated |

### How to use the Kling 4.0 Flash API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/video/queue` with `"model": "kling-v4-flash-text-to-video"` and your API key.

```bash
# 1. Queue the job (returns a queue_id)
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/video/queue \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "kling-v4-flash-text-to-video",
    "prompt": "Slow aerial drone shot over a misty mountain valley at golden hour",
    "duration": "5s",
    "resolution": "720p",
    "aspect_ratio": "16:9"
  }'

# 2. Poll until the MP4 is ready
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/video/retrieve \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{ "model": "kling-v4-flash-text-to-video", "queue_id": "<queue_id>" }' --output video.mp4
```
